exports: create_app(artifact_dir: str | None = None, processed_dir: str | None = None, mock_mode: bool = false, strict_artifacts: bool = true) -> Flask
score_request(payload: dict, runtime: dict, mock_mode: bool = false) -> dict

dependencies.processed_manifest: data/processed/processed_artifact_manifest.json is required in strict real mode
dependencies.builders: FULL and REDUCED builders must be loaded only via src/builder_artifacts.py
dependencies.metadata: artifacts/reproducibility_report.json is optional but preferred for /health version metadata

behavior.startup_mode: real mode is eager and fail-fast; runtime is loaded once and stored immutably on the Flask app
behavior.builder_policy: Module 5 must not rebuild or refit builders in normal mode
behavior.request_time_data_policy: live scoring must not read raw child CSVs or processed split pickle files
behavior.diagnostic_only: data/processed/app_test_adv.pkl is diagnostic-only and not used for live scoring

status.terminal_consumer: Module 5 is the terminal consumer of the persisted lineage-validated artifact stack
